methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: A maintenance strategy for DSM projects was therefore developed and is presented in this paper.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Presents a performance-centred maintenance (PCM) strategy built on the plan-do-check-act cycle for industrial DSM projects. DSM performance is tracked as peak-load impact (MW) versus a fixed project target, but no EnPI/EnB measurement model is identified or characterised: no normalisation variables, no functional form, and no construction/estimation approach are given. This is a maintenance/management framework without EnPI/EnB measurement-model content.

paper_type.evidence_quote: A strategy for continuous performance improvement and known as the performance-centred maintenance strategy was introduced in this paper.

stage1.notes: Energy-adjacent (ISO 50001, DSM peak-load performance vs target, KPIs) but the deliverable is a maintenance framework, not an EnPI/EnB model. Application context is deep-level gold mining (dewatering pumps), which is out of Corpus-B scope regardless.
